last_tests.command: Two offline/privacy passes + production dependency/cache verification
last_tests.result: 34/34 static/runtime contract checks passed: manifest, service-worker and runtime syntax, complete production precache, local-only module graph, offline fallback/update flow, truthful controller-backed offline status, and diagnostics without fake observations.
last_tests.scope: Production source/cache contract verified; physical install/offline launch on iPhone/GitHub Pages still requires device/browser execution.

blockers: Dataset-backed real-photo reject metrics are not available until real labeled photos are supplied
Physical iPhone camera/library, IndexedDB and installed-PWA offline regression still needs device/browser verification
Species recognition remains intentionally disabled until subject reject is validated on real images

recognition_metrics.note: No claim of real-image recognition accuracy

implemented: Canonical RC3 runtime and fail-closed Field guard
Offline local pixel subject-evidence adapter and conservative multi-view aggregation
UNKNOWN/REJECT mobile guidance and labeled offline dataset evaluator
Authoritative camera/library preprocessing validates type/empty/size/decode and downsizes oversized images before RC3 analysis
iPhone Field input now allows camera or photo-library choice rather than forcing capture
IndexedDB open/transaction flow handles blocked, versionchange, abort and error states
Observation save validates required real photo data and preserves photos/form on persistence failure for retry
Observation subjectStatus is persisted as plant/uncertain/non-plant/unknown without promoting species
Book has real empty/error/retry states, verified-only species counting, newest-first pending observations and per-observation delete
Persisted observation detail sheet opens real saved entries with their actual photos, habitat, region/place, GPS, altitude, quality and useful-view count
Taxonomy is rendered only when verification==='verified'; manual names and UNKNOWN/UNCERTAIN/NON-PLANT remain explicitly non-verified
Observation detail supports keyboard/backdrop/Escape close, focus return, corrupt-photo fallback and safe delete with recovery
Installable local PWA manifest with local Herbarium identity/icon and standalone scope
Versioned service worker precaches the canonical shell, runtime and all production subject/acquisition modules with offline navigation fallback
Service-worker update flow exposes a controlled in-app update action and removes old Herbarium caches
Runtime network badge says offline-ready only when a service worker actually controls the app
Production shell has no required external src/href, external fetch or external module import
Local diagnostics now verify meta-store persistence without creating synthetic observations
next_action: Close the performance package with measured before→after work: instrument image acquisition/analysis timing and memory-sensitive dimensions locally, eliminate duplicate image decoding/compression where safe, cap retained preview payloads, and verify camera→subject gate→save still preserves UNKNOWN semantics.
